name: Malaysia Live TV
description: Free-to-air live TV channels from RTM (Radio Televisyen Malaysia): TV1, TV2, TV6, Berita RTM, RTM Parlimen (Dewan Rakyat & Dewan Negara). Every stream points directly at RTM's own official CloudFront CDN - no third-party mirrors.
